If you are new to lisaR, start with the four steps below. For your own analysis,
you need a complete
differential-expression table; lisaR calculates enrichment from that table,
not differential expression from sequencing reads.

## Get started

1. **[Install lisaR](installation.html)** in R or RStudio.
2. **[Run Riaz ON](riaz-on-quick-start.html)** to make your first report from
   prepared public data.
3. **[Use your own DE](use-your-own-de.html)** by replacing the input table and
   stating the direction of your comparison.
4. **[Read your report](read-your-report.html)** and inspect the gene sets
   behind a category.

You can follow this route without writing YAML or choosing advanced options.
The Riaz example downloads its data and gene-set resource. If you need an
offline demonstration instead, use the [synthetic example](quick-start.html).

## Go further

[Advanced guides](advanced.html) cover statistical analysis, multiple analyses,
custom resources and additional report products. You do not need them to
complete the first run.

For a specific argument or error, consult the
[function reference](function-reference.html),
[configuration reference](configuration-reference.html) or
[troubleshooting guide](troubleshooting.html).

[Licence and citation](licence-and-citation.html) explains software attribution
and the terms that apply to external resources.
